# Hellraiser Revival Guides

> Independent English-language fan guide for Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival.

## Scope

Source-linked summaries, not independently playtested. Artwork is illustrative and AI-generated, not gameplay footage. Opening walkthrough notes are not a complete campaign guide.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search and six guide categories.
- [Guide library](/guides/): Text search, category filters and saved guides.
- [What the game is & how to play](/beginners-guide/): What Hellraiser: Revival is, how its combat and puzzle boxes work, and the habits that make the first hours go smoothly.
- [Walkthrough: where to begin](/walkthrough/): Opening objectives, a first puzzle hint and a route to the full walkthrough.
- [Puzzle solutions: the first locks](/puzzles/): Two early mechanisms explained, with hints before the solution.
- [Collectibles & your firearm checklist](/collectibles/): The four collectible groups, missable-item advice and a saved firearm checklist.
- [Locker codes & safe combinations](/locker-codes/): Five location-specific combinations, hidden until you need them.
- [Trophies: plan a safer completion run](/trophies/): Save planning, collectible requirements and the reported shop-trophy issue.
- [PC crashing: start with these checks](/crashing-fix/): Official PC requirements, Steam file verification and useful support details.
- [The Genesis Configuration](/genesis-configuration/): The puzzle box at the center of Aidan’s story and supernatural abilities.
- [About and editorial policy](/about/): Coverage, sources and affiliation.
- [Privacy](/privacy/): Browser-local storage, analytics and external links.

## Interactions

Optional solution and code reveals; code-copy buttons; local bookmarks; five-firearm checklist saved in browser local storage. No account, sync or advertising integration; aggregate usage measured with Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity on the published site only, disabled on local copies.

## Maintenance

Guide data and source links: src/content.js. This file is generated by scripts/prerender.mjs during npm run build. Last content review: October 12, 2026.
